dnd.instructions: To move a bar, focus it and press Space or Enter, then use the left and right arrow keys to move it by a day (Shift: a week), Space or Enter to drop it, Escape to cancel. Focus a bar's start or end handle to change that edge instead.

announce.startMove: Picked up {{name}}, {{start}} to {{end}}. Left and right arrows move it by a day, with Shift by a week; Space drops it, Escape cancels.
announce.startResizeStart: Resizing the start of {{name}}, {{start}} to {{end}}. Left and right arrows change it by a day, with Shift by a week.
announce.startResizeEnd: Resizing the end of {{name}}, {{start}} to {{end}}. Left and right arrows change it by a day, with Shift by a week.
announce.startTray: Picked up {{name}} from the unscheduled list.
announce.dropRefused: {{name}} was not changed: a save is still running. Try again in a moment.
announce.startRow: Picked up {{name}}, position {{position}} of {{count}}. Move the pointer to the new place and release; Escape cancels.
announce.startDraw: Drawing {{name}}. Move the pointer across the days and release; Escape cancels.
